7_scoring_rules.SILENCE_PRECISION: EXACT AND MECHANICAL. Frozen truth owes nothing on a SILENCE row, so a row is correct iff ZERO clarifications were emitted. Any clarification there is unnecessary by definition. No semantic judgement, no authored target.
7_scoring_rules.REQUIRED_RECALL_LOOSE: MECHANICAL UPPER BOUND. Correct iff at least one clarification was emitted. This does NOT establish that the question addressed the owed fact.
7_scoring_rules.REQUIRED_RECALL_STRICT: NOT COMPUTED BY THIS SCRIPT. The frozen §174 record has MATERIAL_UNRESOLVED_FACTS = null on 10/10 rows, so no human-supplied target exists. Every emitted clarification is exported verbatim for human adjudication instead.
7_scoring_rules.BALANCED_ACCURACY: Reported as a RANGE only: the lower bound assumes every REQUIRED emission missed its fact, the upper bound assumes every one hit. A point estimate is not available.
7_scoring_rules.ROW_LEVEL_ACCURACY: Reported as the same range, for the same reason.

8_malformed_handling: A response failing contract validation is recorded as CONTRACT_FAILURE and scored as NO clarification emitted. It is never silently retried and never dropped.

9_retry_policy.note: zero. A failed call is recorded as a failure.

12_interpretation_rules.sharedAuthorship: Claude authored the rows; GPT-5.6 Sol reviewed before owner finalization; Expert HazLenz is Claude-family. A high score does NOT remove provenance uncertainty.
12_interpretation_rules.ifTenOfTen: PERFECT_DEVELOPMENT_CONCORDANCE — SHARED_MODEL_FAMILY_INSTRUMENT_CHALLENGE_REQUIRED. Do not declare validated. Do not discard the ten rows.
12_interpretation_rules.ifBelowTenOfTen: Each failure is initially MODEL_OR_CONTRACT_FAILURE_CANDIDATE. Do not blame the instrument without identifying a specific defect in the frozen wording.
12_interpretation_rules.allAskOrAllSilent: Neither may be described as successful balanced clarification behaviour.
12_interpretation_rules.truthIsNotRedefined: Frozen verdicts are never edited to agree with Expert.

uniformInputDecision.derivation: union of families the real deterministic decomposer emits across the ten frozen observations; IDENTICAL for every row so it cannot separate the classes
uniformInputDecision.whyThisIsSafe: clarifications are not family-gated — the hazardFamily enum constrains hazard CANDIDATES only — so the vocabulary cannot prevent Expert from asking about anything
uniformInputDecision.inspectionContext: location null, task null, for every row

knownInputAsymmetry.observed: the deterministic decomposer emits a different number of findings per row
knownInputAsymmetry.note: recorded BEFORE the run as a limitation on interpretation, not discovered afterwards
